base: Create ONE standalone game avatar PNG, transparent background. Use the supplied approved puppy portrait as the strict identity and art-style reference. Keep its wide round cream-white face, two floppy dusty gray-blue ears, dusty blue patch around the eye on VIEWER RIGHT, dark warm brown rounded hand-painted outlines, tiny canine nose, pale peach blush, restrained gouache dry brush inside flat colored areas. Match the reference head proportions and silhouette very closely across the set. Front view, centered complete head, almost square canvas, 8% clear padding, unclipped ears and decorations. No hamster round upright ears, no whiskers, no body, neck, clothes, collar, hat, bakery props, badge, frame, colored tile, ground, shadow, text, watermark, paper background or 3D. Paws only when specified; paws cream white with soft warm brown outline, canine not human. Expression:
